hazards.title: No guardrails on rolling scaffold
hazards.description: Two workers stand on the elevated platform of the yellow rolling scaffold in the center, which has no guardrails or midrails around its open edges and no visible fall protection.
hazards.category: Working at Heights and Fall Protection

hazards.title: Scaffold caster resting on debris
hazards.description: The front-left caster of the occupied rolling scaffold sits on broken wood and drywall pieces instead of the level floor, which could let the scaffold shift or tip.

hazards.title: Tools near platform edge without toeboards
hazards.description: A cordless drill, a red toolbox, a cardboard box and other tools sit near the edges of the scaffold platform, and there are no toeboards to stop them falling onto people below.

hazards.title: No exclusion zone below overhead work
hazards.description: The area beneath and around the scaffold where workers are installing overhead cable trays is not barricaded or marked, while other workers move through the open floor nearby.

hazards.title: Debris scattered on walking surface
hazards.description: Broken wood, drywall fragments and plastic wrap are on the floor at the scaffold base, and wood scraps and loose materials lie near the cart on the left, creating trip hazards.
